Body.Content:
Moving resources:  You can now navigate to a resource group and start the journey to move resources to another region.  You'll then be able to add missing dependencies, customize destination properties, and track the progress of your moves.

Filter pills: Filter pills now open dialogs, which brings consistency to the filtering experience while also making it fully accessible and WCAG 2.1 compliant.
